answer: A farm cannot present clean aliases since the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Histories are stored in wander, checked in marble, and walnut exposes each void. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 20 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 1092 identities would post 4220 proofs and burn roughly 88 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
